ideas.title: FBI's investigation blockage in Minneapolis ICE shooting
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI's decision to block Minnesota officials from investigating the fatal ICE shooting
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential obstruction of justice
questions: What was the reason for the blockage?
What impact did it have on the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal potential wrongdoing or abuse of power by the FBI
